title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: A team challenge to finish
hook: How does your team finish practice?
intro: Kids drift to the parking lot.
statement: A shared challenge ends practice as a team.
q1: Do you end with a team challenge everyone works on —
q2: or end with a quick talk and dismissal?
q3: What would your team try to beat?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But kids leave together
t2: when practice ends on something shared.
cta: Coaches — how do you finish practice?
ctaLines: Team catch record. Beat the coach. A cheer.
ctaPrompt: Share your closing habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How does your team finish practice?
Practice just stops. Kids drift to the parking lot.
A shared challenge ends practice as a team.
A team challenge or a quick talk. Both can work.
How do you finish practice? Share your habit in the comments.
